page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.2xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 8 vCPUs. The memory configuration consists of 32.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a KVM hypervisor. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a single-core stress-ng score of 1563.99 and a multi-core score of 8283.11. Memory performance is characterized by a cached read bandwidth of 462.63 GB/sec, which drops to 59.02 GB/sec for uncached large block reads, and a write speed of 40.88 GB/sec. In application-specific tests, the instance achieves a Geekbench multi-core score of 5125.0, with notable performance in software compilation at 7735.0 and ray tracing at 6435.0. Redis SET operations reach 8.0 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput is measured at 7.87 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7ne.2xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for general-purpose workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation without the overhead of local storage or specialized GPU hardware. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it a viable candidate for mid-tier database operations, web serving, software compilation, and general enterprise applications. The lack of local storage requires architectural planning for external block storage, which represents a tradeoff for I/O-intensive workloads but ensures flexibility in stateless application deployments.
